report.incidentSummary: On the morning of 2026-10-14, users reported that mutual fund holdings and P&L displayed stale, yesterday-dated values while stock valuations updated normally. The issue was caused by a fatal parse error in the market-data-service nightly nav-import job at 2026-10-13 18:02 UTC (23:32 IST), where an unexpected 'N.A.' string at line 8982 of AMFI's NAVAll.txt aborted the ingestion of all 14,231 mutual fund NAVs. The job exited with an error and was not retried, leaving NAVs from 2026-10-12 active and causing nav_age_s to exceed 34 hours. Downstream, portfolio-service safely fell back to the last available NAVs from 2026-10-12.
report.rootCauseStatement: During the nightly NAV ingestion job on 2026-10-13 at 18:02:00 UTC (23:32 IST), market-data-service failed while parsing the downloaded NAVAll.txt file due to an unhandled non-numeric value ('N.A.') for scheme code 118191 at line 8982. The job aborted without writing any of the 14,231 updated NAVs, leaving the previous day's NAVs (2026-10-12) active. The job-scheduler recorded exit code 1 and executed no automated retries, resulting in stale fund valuations for users when markets opened on 2026-10-14.

hypotheses.cause: market-data-service nav-import job crashed on unhandled 'N.A.' NAV value in AMFI's NAVAll.txt for scheme 118191, aborting full ingestion without retry and leaving 2026-10-12 NAVs active
hypotheses.rationale: Direct logs from market-data-service confirm nav-import downloaded NAVAll.txt at 18:01:00 UTC but threw a parse error at line 8982 for invalid NAV 'N.A.' on scheme 118191 at 18:02:00 UTC, aborting with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written. Job-scheduler logged exit code 1 at 18:06:00 UTC and never retried. nav_age_s climbed continuously to >34 hours, and portfolio-service logged fallback warnings to 2026-10-12 NAVs.

hypotheses.cause: portfolio-service deployment CHG-48221 (version 7.2.0 -> 7.3.0) containing a valuation code refactor introduced a regression in fund valuation logic
hypotheses.rationale: Although CHG-48221 was deployed at 03:40:00 UTC (09:10 IST), coinciding with user complaint onset, portfolio-service had already been logging stale NAV fallback warnings as early as 02:16:24 UTC on version 7.2.0. Valuation errors remained low and baseline, confirming portfolio-service valuation logic was functioning as intended while handling stale upstream data.

hypotheses.cause: External provider amfi-nav-feed failed to publish NAV updates or delayed publishing past the scheduled window
hypotheses.rationale: In past incident PIR-2001, AMFI published late, resulting in no file being found. In this incident, logs show NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) was successfully downloaded on schedule at 18:01:00 UTC, refuting feed absence or delayed publication.

facts.statement: job-scheduler started the nav-import job (run_7fadae4b) on 2026-10-13 at 18:00:00.000Z (23:30 IST).
market-data-service downloaded NAVAll.txt (1980 KB) from amfi-nav-feed at 18:01:00.000Z on 2026-10-13.

market-data-service logged a parse error at line 8982 ('invalid NAV value 'N.A.' for scheme code 118191') at 18:02:00.000Z and aborted the import with 0 of 14,231 NAVs written, leaving the previous NAV set active.

job-scheduler logged that job nav-import failed (run_7fadae4b) with exit code 1 at 2026-10-13 18:06:00.000Z, and no further retries or runs of nav-import were executed through 2026-10-14 05:00:00.000Z.
nav_age_s on market-data-service climbed monotonically from 82,740s at 2026-10-13 17:00 UTC to 125,160s (~34.8 hours) at 2026-10-14 04:45 UTC without resetting.

inferences.statement: The user-reported symptom that mutual fund values were stale while stock values were normal is explained by stock prices coming from the live broker-api feed while fund NAVs rely on the failed nightly AMFI import pipeline.
The deployment CHG-48221 did not cause the stale valuations because stale NAV warnings on portfolio-service began over an hour before the deployment on version 7.2.0.
The nav-import process treats invalid or missing scheme NAV values as fatal batch-level errors rather than skipping individual corrupted records or utilizing partial ingestion.

assumptions.statement: AMFI periodically includes 'N.A.' in NAVAll.txt for suspended, matured, or newly listed mutual fund schemes where NAV calculation is unavailable.

confidence.rationale: Direct log records pinpoint the exact failure mechanism in market-data-service (parse error on line 8982 for scheme code 118191 with value 'N.A.'), the job-scheduler failure log, the lack of subsequent retries, and the monotonic increase of nav_age_s matching stale portfolio displays.

recommendedActions.action: Manually trigger the nav-import job with a temporary parser override or filtered NAV file to update market-data-service with current NAVs.
recommendedActions.rationale: Restores current mutual fund NAV valuations immediately for affected users.
recommendedActions.verification: Check market-data-service metric nav_age_s resets to <3600s and portfolio-service ceases logging stale NAV warnings.

recommendedActions.action: Update the NAV parser in market-data-service to gracefully handle non-numeric values such as 'N.A.' by skipping the scheme or logging a warning without aborting the entire batch.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents a single unpriced fund scheme from halting daily NAV updates for all 14,000+ mutual fund schemes.
recommendedActions.verification: Run unit and integration tests passing mock NAVAll.txt files containing 'N.A.', null, and blank NAV entries.

recommendedActions.action: Configure job-scheduler retry policies and alerting for nav-import failures, including alerting on-call when nav_age_s exceeds 26 hours.
recommendedActions.rationale: The failure at 23:36 IST went unnoticed overnight because exit code 1 did not alert on-call or trigger an automated retry.
recommendedActions.verification: Simulate job failure in staging and confirm on-call paging triggers and retry executes.
